name: The Wanderer+
subtitle: Single-player cheats with a mod menu: stats, combat, crafting, item spawner.
description:
The Wanderer: Post-Nuclear RPG with the Accretion mod menu built in (tap the floating button).

Work on any phone, no JIT needed:
• Health, hunger, thirst, morale never drop
• Lockpicks never break
• Spawn an item: a list of the game's 145 items with an amount slider
• Give a random item / weapon every 10 s
• Player, pet and companion take no damage
• Enemies deal no damage, player always crits, enemies never heal
• Weapon damage ×1-20
• No radiation damage
• Items never wear out
• Unlimited skill points
• Pet never hungry, thirsty or hurt
• Keep screen awake

Needs JIT, marked (JIT) otherwise:
• Crafting uses no materials

Nothing the game sells is touched: caps, tokens, bag upgrades, fuel, fast travel, revives, supply drops and experience boosts stay as they are. Single-player only.

Hooks are checked against The Wanderer 10.1; on other versions missing ones stay off. Installs next to the original app.
